T: Rush on the stereo. Snacks on the couch.
D: A friendless groom-to-be goes on a series of man-dates to find a best man and meets the one guy who gets him.
P: Serve the snacks when Peter and Sydney head to the gig.
S: Beer-battered fish, slaw, pickled onion and chipotle mayo in tortillas

Beer-battered white fish fried crisp in warm tortillas with lime slaw, pickled red onion and chipotle mayo, finished with coriander. Slice 1 red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes. Toss a quarter of a shredded cabbage with lime and salt. Mix 120g mayo with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo. Whisk 120g flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 180ml cold beer. Cut 500g white fish into strips, dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes. Warm 8 tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, onion, mayo and coriander.
Corn chips with pulled pork, black beans, cheddar and lime sour cream

Corn chips layered with smoky pulled pork, black beans and cheddar, baked until melted, loaded with jalapeños, sour cream and a lime crema drizzle. Toss 400g pulled pork with 3 tbsp barbecue sauce. Spread 300g corn chips on a big tray and scatter with the pork, 400g drained black beans and 200g grated cheddar. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes until melted. Mix 150g sour cream with the juice of 1 lime and drizzle over. Top with sliced pickled jalapeños, diced tomato, coriander and spring onion.
M: Rare roast beef, rocket, pickled onion and horseradish cream in a baguette

Crusty baguettes piled with rare roast beef, horseradish cream, rocket, pickled red onion and crispy shallots, cut into share-size pieces. Slice 1 red onion thin and soak in 80ml red wine vinegar with 1 tsp sugar for 20 minutes. Mix 100g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish and salt. Split 2 baguettes lengthways, spread with the horseradish cream and layer with 400g sliced rare roast beef, a handful of rocket, the drained onion and 2 tbsp fried shallots. Press down and cut each into 4 pieces.
W: Lemon cupcakes for Peter and Zooey
Lemon cupcakes filled with lemon curd, cream cheese frosting on top

Lemon butter cupcakes filled with tangy lemon curd and topped with whipped cream cheese icing, a sugared lemon zest curl on each. Heat the oven to 175C. Beat 125g butter and 150g caster sugar with the zest of 2 lemons, add 2 eggs, then 200g self-raising flour and 120ml milk. Bake in 12 cases for 18 minutes and cool. Cut a small hole in each and fill with lemon curd (150g total). Beat 150g cream cheese with 80g soft butter and 300g icing sugar, pipe on top and finish with lemon zest.
K: Tequila, pink grapefruit and lime topped with soda, salted rim

Tequila with fresh pink grapefruit, lime and a touch of agave, topped with soda over ice in a salt-rimmed glass with a grapefruit wedge. Rub the rims of 4 tall glasses with lime and dip in salt. Fill with ice. To each add 45ml tequila, 60ml fresh pink grapefruit juice, 15ml lime juice and 10ml agave syrup and stir. Top with 100ml soda water and add a grapefruit wedge. For drivers, skip the tequila and add more grapefruit and soda.
